title: Full Compile Sweep
summary: Recompiles every unit of a project (a forced full build, refresh-findings --full) and refreshes its stored compiler findings
intro: Read this when you want a complete, current set of compiler diagnostics for a project rather than only what went stale. Choose drag-lint > Full Compile Sweep; it recompiles everything and refreshes the stored findings, like refresh-findings --full.

steps: Open the project in the IDE
Every unit is recompiled (refresh-findings --full, not only the stale ones) and the stored findings refreshed, then the open file is refreshed

surfaces.usage: drag-lint refresh-findings --project <X.dproj> [--db <db>] [--full] [--json] (recompile stale units + refresh compiler_findings; >=2 stale -> full build; no --db = the project's own DB)
help: drag-lint refresh-findings --project <X.dproj> [--db <db>] [--full] [--json]   (recompile stale units + refresh compiler_findings; >=2 stale -> full build; no --db = the project's own DB)

questions.ask: How do I refresh the stored compiler findings for a project?
How do I force a full build instead of the stale-count threshold?
